youtube.title: How your keyboard knows which key you pressed ⌨️ #shorts
youtube.description:
Under the keys is a grid of wires – rows and columns. A tiny chip scans it row by row hundreds of times a second. When a row and a column connect, it knows which key it is. That’s why some keyboards get confused when you press many keys at once.
